description: Ambiq Apollo3 Blue (SparkFun Artemis: Cortex-M4F 48/96 MHz, 1 MB flash, 384 KB RAM, BLE 5)
core_note: SparkFun's Apollo3 Arduino core (Mbed OS 6 underneath), the version releases are built with.
gcc_note: The Apollo3 core's own toolchain (GCC 8-2018-q4), the one Baseline is built with: the same libc, libm and libstdc++.
gcc_download_note: For flick setup (no Arduino IDE): the compiler the Apollo3 core 2.2.1 installs (its package index, tool arm-none-eabi-gcc 8-2018-q4-major). The Intel Mac build also runs on Apple silicon (Rosetta); there is no ARM Linux build.
cflags_note: As the core builds Baseline: hard-float calls, so float arguments pass in FPU registers on both sides of the API table.
libs_note: newlib supplies memcpy, strlen, ... (the SDK's malloc/printf come first).
defines_note: Not ARDUINO_ARCH_APOLLO3: libraries would pick code paths for a core the SDK does not have.
baseline_libraries_note: Libraries inside Baseline, at these versions, installed by flick into Baseline's own sketchbook (%LOCALAPPDATA%/Flick/apollo3-sketchbook): ArduinoBLE is the BLE host (LGPL-2.1).
baseline_defines_note: ArduinoBLE then leaves out its GAP and ATT objects; bl_apollo3_ble.cpp supplies subclasses of them.
usb_vids_note: The Artemis boards' USB serial is a CH340.
stop_detect_note: Baseline parks a sketch spinning in an empty while(1) instead of letting the watchdog roll it back (flick test step 4).
